{{Quote|Our biggest, most stacked slider! Piled high with two patties, triple cheese, deep-fried Tapani triangles, mega-leaf lettuce, a slice of algae-bread, Boontaspiced mustard, plankton spread, larded neutrinos and a fried blubberbird egg, with a green jumbolive on top, it's just the thing to satisfy a Herglic-sized hunger.|Dex's Diner menu, on the Giju slider|<ref name="Dining at Dex's" />}}
'''Plankton spread''' was an ingredient used by the [[Chef/Legends|chef]] [[Dexter Jettster/Legends|Dexter Jettster]] at his [[Dex's Diner/Legends|diner]]<ref name="Dining at Dex's" /> on the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]<ref name="Atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. The [[Foodstuff/Legends|spread]] was included in the diner's [[giju slider]]s which Jettster was inspired to created<ref name="Dining at Dex's" /> by the planet [[Giju/Legends|Giju]]<ref name="Dark Force Rising">''[[Dark Force Rising Sourcebook]]''</ref> located in the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the glaxay]].<ref name="Atlas">

==Behind the scenes==
Plankton spread was mentioned in "[[Dining at Dex's]]," an article written by [[Gregory Walker]] as an [[in-universe]] menu for Dex's Diner that was published on the [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] section of [[StarWars.com]] on [[December 3]], [[2009]].<ref name="Dining at Dex's" />
